title: Blue versus red for perceived trust in brand and interface contexts
statement:
Blue increases perceived trust more than red in brand and interface contexts, supported by both implicit and explicit measures.

Options:
- Institutional blue: #003366 navy (fits: legacy bank, hospital brand)
- Modern trust blue: #007BFF bright blue (fits: fintech app, telehealth)
- Alert red: #DC143C crimson (fits: error state, urgent CTA)
- Competent blue: #4169E1 royal blue (fits: professional services)
appliesWhen: Applies to: fintech, health. Audience: adults, b2b buyers, general.

source.title: Trustworthy Blue or Untrustworthy Red: The Influence of Colors on Trust
source.venue: Journal of Marketing Theory and Practice
